connector.name: Argo MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Argo RPG Platform - connects AI assistants to campaign data via OAuth2
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.argo.games over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package argo-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the argo-rpg-platform account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OAUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Argo OAuth2 access token from the consent flow at https://app.argo.games/oauth2/mcp-connect

env.name: REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Argo OAuth2 refresh token. Enables automatic renewal of the access token when it expires (~1 hour).

env.name: ARGO_API_BASE
env.description: Override the Argo WebAPI base URL. Defaults to https://api.argo.games.
